name: lockwords-fn
description: Netlify functions for the Lockwords funnel: deck ideas, decks, sentence checks and word-count estimate with Claude; deck picture sheets with OpenAI Images and pronunciation with OpenAI text-to-speech (Netlify Blobs)

scripts.build: esbuild netlify/functions/lw-ai.mjs netlify/functions/lw-img.mjs netlify/functions/lw-img-background.mjs netlify/functions/lw-tts.mjs --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
